meta.name: full-investigation
meta.description: Complete Tier 2 investigation workflow. Orchestrates deep investigation of escalated cases: deep-dive-ioc, correlate-ioc, specialized triage (malware/login), pivot-on-ioc, and generate comprehensive report. Use for escalated cases requiring thorough analysis.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动完成深度安全调查并生成报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要处理升级的安全事件并进行全面分析
copy.tagline_en: Automate deep security investigations and generate reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle escalated security cases with thorough analysis

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会执行完整的二级安全调查工作流：对主要IOC进行深度分析、关联现有案件、根据警报类型进行专业分类（恶意软件/可疑登录等）、扩展调查、评估结果并生成调查报告。
howto.when: 当收到需要深入分析的升级安全案件时，例如用户提供了案件ID或要求进行完整调查时触发。

say.note: 触发全流程调查，包括深度分析、关联和报告生成。

say.text: 调查勒索软件警报，主要IOC是文件哈希abc123。
say.note: 指定警报类型和IOC，Claude会路由到恶意软件分类。

say.text: 为这个升级案件生成调查报告。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude executes a complete Tier 2 security investigation workflow: deep analysis of primary IOCs, correlation with existing cases, specialized triage based on alert type (malware/suspicious login), expansion, assessment, and report generation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when an escalated security case requiring thorough analysis is received, e.g., user provides a case ID or requests a full investigation.

say_en.text: Run a full investigation on case CASE-123.
say_en.note: Triggers the complete workflow including deep dive, correlation, and report.

say_en.text: Investigate a ransomware alert with file hash abc123.
say_en.note: Specifies alert type and IOC; Claude routes to malware triage.

say_en.text: Generate investigation report for this escalated case.
say_en.note: Executes only the report generation phase.
